name: sm712_capacitance
spice:
* Datasheet capacitance; typical comparison tolerance is author-selected
.OPTIONS TEMP=25
Xc1 c1v c1b 0 MY_LIB_CDSOT23_SM712_DS
Vc1 c1v 0 DC 0 AC 0.03
.PLOT AC V(c1v) I(Vc1)
Xc2 c2a c2v 0 MY_LIB_CDSOT23_SM712_DS
Vc2 c2v 0 DC 0 AC 0.03
.PLOT AC V(c2v) I(Vc2)
.AC LIN 2 1Meg 1.001Meg
.END

provenance.notes: SM p1 CD75pF TYPICAL at0V/1MHz, +/-1% verifies chosen nominal scenario, not guaranteed product tolerance. USB Table2 Ci/o-GND max3.5pF at1.65V; Fig1 uses1MHz/30mVrms. Fixture VBUS5V AC-ground, unused I/O floating; at27C indicative vs25C. Equivalent series capacitance from external port impedance.
provenance.numerical_tolerance: DC voltages 1 mV; leakage 1 nA; capacitance typical comparison +/-1%; these are test tolerances, not manufacturer tolerances
